testcase.name: Scenario: Double-click an inactive tab in tabs-only display: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:270:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Double-click an inactive tab in tabs-only display ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes ✔ And Tools is the active tab in tabs-only ribbon display ✔ When the user double-clicks the inactive View tab ✔ Then View becomes the active tab ✔ And its command groups appear in a temporary panel ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the temporary command groups close ✔ And View remains the active tab in tabs-only display ✔ When the user double-clicks the active View tab ✔ Then the full View command groups are visible
